- `memory.bench.orders` (1,200 rows, full CY2025 Jan 1–Dec 31, amounts in cents, has `status` values pending/completed/refunded and a `discount` column) appears to be the authoritative source-of-truth revenue table.
- `memory.bench.legacy_orders` (60 rows) is a legacy/duplicate table whose `total` values exactly match `orders.amount/100` for matching order_ids — i.e., it's a deprecated subset, not the full revenue record.
- `memory.bench.daily_region_revenue` (625 rows) only covers Jan 1–Nov 30, 2025 — it is incomplete for the full fiscal year and therefore not suitable as the FY2025 total revenue source.

The correct approach per typical reporting policy would be to sum `(amount - discount)` for `status = 'completed'` orders in `memory.bench.orders`, converting cents to dollars (÷100), for order_ts within calendar year 2025.
